source_projection_basis.note: Reuse existing 153-row locator/routing join; do not treat the source-worklist historical bucket labels as current decisions. Apply only explicit current branch MPR corrections for HIL-NFR-14 and HIL-BR-19.

purpose: Join each existing IR identity to already available source locators, historical audit rows, known route IDs, exact latest source-linked decisions, and current registered-candidate IDs. This is a source-route projection, not a new source-condition audit.

counts.interpretation: Exclusive primary route: 152 source identities have at least one target with exact adopted-target evidence; HIL-BR-19 has a newly registered OS132 proposal. Registered and rejected target links can coexist as source-level residual/decision history and are retained per row below. Adoption of one target does not establish whole-source meaning coverage.

status_axis_separation.routing: route_class reports where each source identity can be followed in existing audit/decision/candidate evidence or in the new BR19 candidate.
status_axis_separation.adoption: Per target, adopted only when current candidate table says 採択 with its PO decision locator, or when the exact fixed 2026-09-28 PO decision covers the base target and the named L2/L11 rows remain byte-identical. Other registered candidates, rejected revisions, mapped target IDs, formal successor and source-wide meaning coverage remain separate.
status_axis_separation.formal_successor: Existing source holding and formal successor status remain separate; a candidate mapping does not assign a formal successor.
status_axis_separation.meaning_coverage: No row is promoted to whole-source condition proof by this locator/routing projection.

historical_bucket_note: 2026-09-28 audit bucket labels and open_scope_question fields are historical-time annotations. They are not counted as current PO judgment residue unless an exact current decision/scope source confirms it.
po_judgment_remaining_note: Not computed from historical audit open questions. Current PO residue requires exact join to latest decision and exact current candidate/source scope; this projection does not enumerate a PO backlog.
unresolved_scope_note: Any source-worklist scope flags are retained row-locally as historical/source evidence; missing detail is not automatically called a current user decision or new requirement.
limitations: No original IR prose was re-read; each row points to canonical archived IR/source locator and digest.
L2/L11 values are anchor locators from existing route IDs or exact candidate registrations; the projection does not rehash all 153 pair sections.
Old audit labels, MPR registration, adoption decisions, formal successor assignment, and meaning coverage remain distinct axes.
The 2026-09-28 audit historical bucket count is not a current work remaining count.
No 4020-source survey or source-wide re-audit was performed.
Primary adopted route is justified only by the target-level current PO candidate row or named fixed L2/L11 pair comparison embedded per target; sibling source conditions are not inferred.

historical_audit_ref.meaning_coverage_limit: Existing audit label is a row-level audit disposition at its pinned cutoff; never infer complete source condition coverage from target IDs, PO adoption, registration, or formal successor state.
